Offshore wind projects and service providers

Offshore wind projects, and their service providers, have also signed the Fair Work Charter for offshore wind.

As set out in the Fair Work Charter, projects that have signed up will be shown in this list after Contracts for Difference Allocation Round 8 results have been announced. Though they will not be named publicly until then, projects will still be expected to meet their Fair Work Charter commitments.
